prompt.es: Responde la entrevista: un recuerdo, tu opinión actual y una petición cortés.

answer.text: My earliest memory is of my grandmother's kitchen. At that time, I was living with my grandparents in a tiny village, and every morning I would wake up to the smell of fresh bread. I had never seen the sea, so on Sundays we used to walk to the river. These days, my opinion of those years has changed. I'm being more honest with myself, and I'm loving my quiet routine. Before we finish, I was wondering if you could send me a copy of the interview. I was hoping to show it to my family, because I'm very grateful for this chance.

When I was a child, I lived in a small village. At that time I was living with my grandparents, and every summer we would swim in the river. By then my father had already left for work, so I had never seen him in the mornings. These days I'm being honest with myself: I'm loving those memories. Back then, I was living in a small town with my grandparents. Every evening we would sit in the garden, and I used to listen to their stories. I had never travelled abroad, and I was very curious. These days my opinion is different: I'm being more honest, and I'm loving my quiet life. I was wondering if you could send me a copy of the interview, if it's no trouble. I'd be very grateful.
